plan.title: Design system: document the Skills page list and switch classes in the style guide and the pan-style-guide skill
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Two documentation files; well under the surface limits.

narratives.Problem: Commit a443ff0619a added five named CSS classes (.list-group-bar, .list-row, .list-meta, .switch-track-on, .switch-track-locked) for the Skills page. They exist because Tailwind opacity modifiers on the var()-based color tokens compile to no CSS. Neither the style guide nor the pan-style-guide skill mentions them, so the next page will rebuild the tints from opacity utilities that render nothing, and the guide's Switches recipe still says checked tracks are bg-primary.
narratives.Proposal: Document the five classes in design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md (a new §8 subsection, a reconciling paragraph in Switches / Toggles, a §18 quick-reference line) and in sync-sources/dev-skills/pan-style-guide/SKILL.md (a subsection with the reuse rule, an extended sources list, two triggers, a review bullet). The exact inserted text is in the PRD .pan/drafts/pan-5123.md. Then verify that no src/ file changed, the Skills tests pass, and record the post-merge pan sync check in the PR body.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Renaming, removing or restyling any class in src/dashboard/frontend/src/index.css, or editing any file under src/
- Migrating other switches (Settings/Shared/Toggle.tsx, NewConversationDialog.tsx, Settings sections, flywheel/primitives.tsx, MergeTrainSection.tsx) or other lists to the named classes
- Changing tailwind.config.js, including any <alpha-value> rewrite of the color tokens
- Rewriting other guide or skill recipes that use /<n> opacity notation (chips, soft card, keycap, inputs, board filter pills)
- Removing the hardcoded #a078f7 from Settings/Shared/Toggle.tsx
- Editing the OKF knowledge bundle (../overdeck-knowledge)
- Writing to .claude/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/ or ~/.overdeck/skills/, or running the workspace-built CLI's sync to make the global skill copy match before merge

autoDecisions.summary: Issue step 4 (pan sync, confirm the .claude/skills copy matches) becomes a post-merge check recorded in the PR body.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan sync --dry-run from the workspace prints 'Syncing from the checkout it was built from: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/sync-sources' (resolveSyncSourcesRoot in src/lib/paths.ts), so it distributes main, not this branch; the workspace .claude/skills is gitignored and filled only at workspace creation. Step 4 is not in the issue's Acceptance list, so this is not a contradiction.

autoDecisions.summary: Markup examples come from SkillControls.tsx, SkillOverridesPanel.tsx and SkillPacksSection.tsx, not only SkillOverridesPanel.tsx.
autoDecisions.rationale: SkillOverridesPanel.tsx contains only .list-row; the other four classes are used in SkillControls.tsx (lines 32, 97) and SkillPacksSection.tsx (line 213). Real class strings beat invented ones.

autoDecisions.summary: The new subsection is labeled '(both themes)', not Broadsheet-only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The rules in index.css are not scoped to a data-theme and read only --muted and --foreground, which both themes define.

autoDecisions.summary: Amend §8 Switches / Toggles with a paragraph instead of rewriting its bg-primary recipe.
autoDecisions.rationale: Other switches still use the old recipe until their page moves; the issue's one-page-at-a-time rule means the old recipe stays documented as pre-PAN-5123.

autoDecisions.summary: Add 'list row' and 'switch' to the skill's triggers.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's stated failure mode is that the next page will not reuse the classes; the skill must load when an agent builds a list or switch.

autoDecisions.summary: The new subsection goes in §8 after Dot-Metadata Line, and the quick-reference line goes directly after BROADSHEET-ONLY.
autoDecisions.rationale: §8 holds the other named-class component patterns; fixing placement removes a two-diffs-both-done ambiguity.

items.title: Style guide: add the Grouped List and Switch Tracks subsection to §8

verify_commands: grep -n '### Grouped List and Switch Tracks (both themes)' design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md
grep -n '### Dot-Metadata Line\|### Status Indicators' design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md
expected_outputs: grep prints exactly one heading line for the new subsection
the new heading's line number sits between the Dot-Metadata Line and Status Indicators headings

narrative.Action: Insert the PRD WI-1 block verbatim into design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md after the Dot-Metadata Line canonical-example paragraph and before '### Status Indicators'. The block names the five classes in a table (what each renders, when to use it), explains that opacity modifiers on the var() color tokens compile to no CSS, shows markup from SkillControls.tsx, SkillOverridesPanel.tsx and SkillPacksSection.tsx, states both-theme scope, and states the one-page-at-a-time adoption rule with no bulk Tailwind config change. Do not edit any other part of the file in this item.

items.title: Given the edited STYLE-GUIDE.md, when grep runs for '### Grouped List and Switch Tracks (both themes)', then it prints exactly one line, located after '### Dot-Metadata Line' and before '### Status Indicators'

The new subsection's table contains a row for each of `.list-group-bar`, `.list-row`, `.list-meta`, `.switch-track-on` and `.switch-track-locked`, each with its token percentage (55%, 45% on hover, 30%, 62%, 28%) and a 'Use it for' sentence

The subsection contains the 'Why named classes' paragraph naming `bg-muted/40` and `bg-foreground/8` as compiling to no CSS, and a tsx code block that contains the class strings `list-group-bar px-3 py-2`, `list-meta`, `list-row grid`, `switch-track-on` and `switch-track-locked`

The subsection contains the phrase 'one page at a time' and states that there is no bulk Tailwind config change, and its Theme scope paragraph says the classes render under Ledger and Broadsheet alike
